questions.lead: The NHK Trophy, a figure skating competition, opened in Tokyo, Japan, on 27 November. The men's short programme world record fell on the first day.

questions.lead: Ilia Malinin of the United States scored 114.81 points in the men's short programme at the NHK Trophy in Tokyo. The record he beat had stood since the 2022 Winter Olympics.

questions.lead: The counting of special votes in New Zealand's general election has produced the final result. One party won the most seats even though it lost the popular vote, for the first time since 1981.

In figure skating, Ilia Malinin of the United States sets a men's short programme world record with 114.81 points at the NHK Trophy in Tokyo, Japan, surpassing compatriot Nathan Chen's previous record of 113.97 points set at the 2022 Winter Olympics.
The election resulted in a hung parliament. The incumbent National-ACT-New Zealand First coalition government holds 65 of the 130 seats.
This is the first election since 1981 in which National won the most seats but lost the popular vote.
The Opportunity Party won 6.1% of the party vote, gaining seven seats and becoming the first new party to be elected to Parliament since 2011.

The counting of special votes results in the National Party losing two electorate seats, including one overhang seat. The National-ACT-NZ First coalition government falls below a majority to 65 seats, placing the Opportunity Party into a kingmaker position.
Whereas elongated teeth, including elephant and walrus tusks and beaver incisors, grow in curved shapes, the male narwhal develops a remarkable corkscrew-shaped tooth.

Typically, the upper left canine grows forward through the upper lip, twisting counterclockwise as it extends. It can reach two meters (6.6 feet) in length, equivalent to as much as half the animal's body length.
